title: OA TABLE 72 - the monthly events: the forty die-range rows of the three columns with the thirty event names
audit_comment: OA round eighty-six (capture p. 238): Table 72 - the monthly events grid, the forty die-range rows across the three columns with the thirty event names and the contiguous ranges, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 72, printed capture p. 238 - the monthly events round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE GRID: the forty die-range rows of the monthly events across the percentile die, the ranges contiguous and complete 1-100, each row read across the three columns - the first for months of armed violence or its potential (war, uprisings, assassinations, political power plays), the second for natural disasters and their aftermaths (floods, typhoons, droughts, famines, plagues and the like), the third when all is right with the world. THE THIRTY NAMES by ordinal: Accident the 1; Bandit Activity the 2; Bad Harvest the 3; Bad Weather the 4; Birth the 5; Death the 6; Earthquake Minor the 7; Excessive Taxes the 8; Famous Person the 9; Fire Major the 10; Fire Minor the 11; Flooding the 12; Haunting the 13; Horrendous Monster the 14; Incursion Major the 15; Incursion Minor the 16; Injustice the 17; Landslide the 18; Maiden of Virtue the 19; Major Battle the 20; Maneater the 21; Marriage the 22; No Event the 23; Notorious Criminal the 24; Plague the 25; Recruiting the 26; Troop Movements the 27; Uprising the 28; Vengeful Stranger the 29; VIP Visit the 30. THE OPEN: the rows 01-05 Accident in all three columns, the rows 95-100 No Event in all three. THE USE: one event per month from the proper column steered by the yearly event, the DM noting each beside the month, free to substitute and to add beyond the list. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus
